# Memory Context Policy — v1.4

## Context Pack
For each task assemble:
- active project brief
- relevant approved memory records
- relevant Scene DNA / Shot DNA
- latest approved asset versions
- required specialist reference
- current task request

## Exclude
- superseded memories
- rejected ideas
- unrelated scenes
- full generation history unless repairing
- inactive agent files

## Context Priority
Current explicit instruction always has highest priority for the current operation, but it does not silently rewrite durable project memory. If it changes a lock, register a deliberate override/new version.
